summary: Register Yandex Market as the third read-only marketplace provider using current Partner API product, price, stock, business-order and inbound-notification surfaces while keeping marketplace writes denied and all Yandex identities outside Core.

impacts.evidence: Business/campaign/warehouse configuration is resolved by the host for the authenticated connector account; provider code has no tenant persistence authority and notification scope is checked against configured account identifiers.
Committed fixtures are synthetic. Order projection intentionally excludes buyer contact/address fields and API-key bytes exist only inside SecretAccessor callbacks.
Task 033 adds no public TORGNEXA HTTP endpoint or OpenAPI operation.
An additive notifications.receive capability and provider-neutral MarketplaceNotification projection are introduced; no EventBus schema is published by the provider.

Frozen Connector/Runtime roots remain unchanged. Task 033 adds additive PriceReader, OrderReader and MarketplaceNotificationDecoder capability-specific SDK projections and notifications.receive vocabulary.
Task 033 adds no migration; connector account, mapping, sync, inbox and reconciliation persistence already exist.

Provider code has no direct network/database/filesystem/process/Core/App authority. Fixed HTTPS host calls are host-mediated, secrets are callback-scoped, bodies are bounded and raw remote/transport text is not disclosed.
Manifest is read/receive-only and grants no product, price, inventory or order-status write capability.
Remote reads/notification decode do not mutate business state; later sync application remains subject to existing audit/lineage obligations.
Offer/order/warehouse IDs remain remote mapping keys; opaque page tokens are configuration-bound and notifications derive deterministic dedupe keys for Task-009 Inbox before Task-013/014 processing.

Outbound Partner API requests use a host-injected transport to fixed api.partner.market.yandex.ru; inbound notification parsing has no direct socket authority and edge source controls remain host-owned.
Auth/rate/service outcomes normalize to bounded SDK health/errors including HTTP 420/429. Endpoint-specific lower remote ceilings remain scheduler/cache policy evidence for Task 066.
Suspend the connector account or remove the provider route to stop reads/notification decode; no database rollback is required.

Synthetic/adversarial fixtures cover products, prices, two inventory modes, orders, notification duplicate/scope behavior, pagination/errors and the canonical Task-064 report passes all thirteen checks.
